Position: Cook 
Type: Full-time 
Employer: Yumko Pty Ltd 
Location: Canberra ACT 2601 
Salary: $79,423 p/a
About the Business
Yumko Pty Ltd is a distinguished culinary establishment in Canberra renowned for its dedication to authentic Korean cuisine. Specialising in traditional and contemporary Korean dishes, the restaurant delivers high-quality dining experiences that celebrate rich flavours, fresh ingredients, and meticulous presentation. With a strong reputation for excellence in the hospitality sector, Yumko values precision, consistency, and cultural authenticity while fostering a supportive, team-oriented workplace culture that encourages professional growth, collaboration, and adherence to the highest standards of food safety and customer satisfaction.
About the Position
The Cook plays a vital role in Yumko Pty Ltd’s kitchen team, responsible for preparing authentic Korean dishes to the highest standards. This full-time position involves setting up workstations, executing recipes with precision, and contributing to the consistent delivery of exceptional meals that uphold the restaurant’s reputation for quality and authenticity. The Cook is essential to maintaining efficient kitchen operations and ensuring every dish meets the expectations of our valued customers.
Key Responsibilities
•	Setting up workstations and operating kitchen equipment
•	Measuring and weighing ingredients
•	Following recipes and set menus
•	Deep frying, pan frying, steaming or boiling meat, vegetables and other foods
•	Presenting and garnishing dishes
•	Adhering to kitchen hygiene and safety standards
•	Maintaining a clean workspace at all times
•	Monitoring stock levels
•	Keeping up with cooking techniques and methods
Requirements
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (or equivalent).
•	Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience as a Cook.
•	Strong technical skills in Korean and general Asian cooking techniques, including frying, steaming, and precise food presentation.
•	Sound knowledge of kitchen hygiene, food safety standards, and stock management.
•	Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced team environment with excellent communication and time-management skills.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

The Vineyard Hotel is a premier hospitality landmark and family-friendly entertainment hub. Spanning an impressive 8-hectare estate on Windsor Road, this iconic venue features a vibrant bistro, an expansive beer garden, live music, and the dedicated "Vineyard Farmhouse" kids' playground, complemented by on-site accommodation at the Gateway Motel.

The Team is currently seeking skilled Cooks and Chefs for full-time positions, offering a competitive salary of $75,000–$85,000 per annum, depending on experience. 
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established venue where quality, creativity, and consistency are truly celebrated.

Scope of the Work:
- Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including staff delegation, stock rotation, and maintaining accurate records.
- Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, either regularly or for special functions and events.
- Managing production schedules and staff requirements to ensure timely service delivery.
- Estimating food supply needs, calculating costs for ingredients, and managing orders accordingly.
- Inspecting supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure adherence to established quality standards.
- Analysing recipes and advising prices to menu items based on food, labour, and overhead costs.
- Working closely with team members to execute established recipes and menus with consistency and precision, ensuring alignment with seasonal availability and anticipated customer volume.
- Demonstrating new cooking techniques and introducing equipment to staff for continual culinary improvement.
- Oversee workstation readiness by ensuring mise en place is complete, equipment is functional, and kitchen operations are primed for service efficiency and food quality standards.
- Prepare and cook dishes in strict compliance with food safety and health regulations, ensuring the highest quality and hygiene standards are maintained.
- Assist in onboarding, training, and supervising new team members, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment.
- Monitoring and enforcing sanitation practices to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including Occupational Health and Safety (WHS) and HACCP.

To be considered for this role, you should:
- Be willing to relocate if you are interstate or in other cities.
- Preferably have Certificates III & IV in Commercial Cookery
- Be available on both days at weekends and be able to work split shifts.
- Have at least 2- 3 years of work experience as a Cook/Chef.
- Ability to work in a team.
- Exceptional communication skills.

What you’ll get in return:
- Opportunities for Career Progression
- Be Part of a Historic, Community-Focused Venue
- Great work environment

About the Business:
Victorian Home and Community Care Pty Ltd (VHCC) is a registered NDIS provider delivering person-centred disability support services across NSW and Victoria. We specialise in community participation, assistance with daily living, personal care (including high-intensity supports), supported independent living, community nursing, psychosocial recovery coaching, support coordination and allied health services. With a team of over 300 multicultural and bilingual care workers, we focus on building independence, dignity and community connection for participants. Our culture values compassion, cultural responsiveness, trauma-informed practice and genuine partnership with participants and families to help them achieve their goals.
About the Position:
The Community Worker role is central to VHCC’s mission of supporting vulnerable people in the Narromine region and surrounds. You will assess community needs, deliver informal counselling and life-skills education, and actively connect participants to essential services so they can live more independently and participate fully in community life. This position plays a key part in translating NDIS plans into practical, meaningful outcomes on the ground.
Key Responsibilities:
Assess individual and community needs to identify barriers and opportunities for greater independence and participation
Provide informal counselling and emotional support to participants and their families
Deliver life-skills education and capacity-building activities tailored to individual goals
Connect participants with essential support services, mainstream community resources and specialist providers
Facilitate community participation and social inclusion activities
Maintain accurate records and contribute to support planning and review processes

result.description:
Sopho Pty Ltd as trustee for the Sopho Unit Trust trading as Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat, operates a distinctive accommodation and hospitality destination in the heart of Kangaroo Valley, NSW, within the Southern Highlands and South Coast region and an easy two-hour drive from both Sydney and Canberra. The Retreat is centred on a historic 1901 Woolshed — relocated from Uri Park in outback NSW and lovingly restored in 1983 — which today houses The Woolshed Restaurant and provides a characterful setting for guests and private functions alike. The property is complemented by an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Jack Newton, and by Osteria La Vallata, an Italian-inspired fine-dining restaurant led by Chef Marco Salvestrin.

Welcoming overnight guests, golf and leisure visitors, function and event parties, and regional tourists, Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat delivers a premium accommodation and hospitality experience across its accommodation, dining, and recreation offerings. As a destination property in a popular regional tourism location, the Retreat depends on attentive, individualised guest care and consistent day-to-day operational oversight to maintain its standing and the high standard of guest experience for which it is known.

As part of its continued growth, Sopho Pty Ltd is seeking to appoint a skilled and experienced Accommodation and Hospitality Manager in a permanent full-time position. The role is responsible for the overall administration and day-to-day operation of Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat, with a primary focus on accommodation services and the personalised guest experience across the property. The role offers a salary range of AUD $75,000 to AUD $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with the successful candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Job tasks and responsibilities
1.  Direct and oversee major accommodation - related operations such as reservations, reception, room service, and housekeeping activities across the property's 30 self-contained one-, two-, and three-bedroom cabins and villas, ensuring that turnaround, presentation, and guest check-in/check-out standards are consistently met.
2.  Plan and coordinate special functions, conferences and private events held in the Conference & Events Centre, liaising with clients on room setup, AV/presentation equipment and catering requirements.
3.  Coordinate closely with the Executive Chef to align front-of-house service delivery with kitchen output, executing and leading front-of-house service across Osteria La Vallata restaurant, in-room dining and event catering to deliver a seamless overall guest hospitality experience.
4.  Direct the Greenkeeper Superintendent and golf course maintenance team to ensure the 18-hole championship course and surrounding grounds are presented and maintained to the standard expected of guests and members.
5.  Supervise security arrangements and, through the Maintenance Manager, the upkeep of buildings, gardens, pools, tennis courts and other recreational facilities used by guests.
6.  Oversee the selection, training, rostering and supervision of accommodation, guest services, maintenance, golf course and other staff, and ensure compliance with occupational health and safety regulations across the site.
7.  Observe liquor licensing, food safety, health and other regulatory requirements relevant to the accommodation, restaurant, golf and function operations.
8.  Assess and review guest and customer satisfaction through feedback channels and online review platforms, and implement service improvements accordingly.
9.  Oversee purchasing and accounting activities related to accommodation, hospitality and course-maintenance operations, including supplier arrangements for housekeeping, maintenance, kitchen and guest amenities.
10.  Provide guests with local tourism information and coordinate golf, dining and activity bookings as part of the retreat experience, arranging tours or transport where required.
11.  Handle guest complaints and service escalations, negotiating with suppliers and other stakeholders to resolve issues, and conduct ongoing quality checks across accommodation, dining and event operations, initiating corrective action where standards are not met.
12.  Lead public relations and marketing initiatives to promote the Retreat and grow accommodation patronage
13.  Report on operational performance, staffing and guest service outcomes to the Operations Manager and General Manager, and contribute to forward operational planning, performance forecasting and risk management to support the retreat's ongoing service standards and growth.

How to join the team
To join our dedicated team for a rewarding career, please submit an online application. Only successful applicants will be contacted. Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or have the capacity to permanently work in Australia. Employment of a temporary visa holder may only occur if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.
